s.note: Thumper telling Bambi to eat the clover and leave the greens
s.how: Separate baby cos lettuce into small cups. Toss pea shoots and mint leaves with lemon juice and olive oil and spoon into each cup. Top with shaved parmesan and toasted pepitas. Serve on a platter in the spring sunshine.

s.note: Flower the skunk in the flower patch
s.how: Whip 200g feta with 200g Greek yoghurt, a spoon of honey and chopped dill until smooth. Spread in a shallow dish and arrange baby carrots, radishes and snow peas around it like a garden bed. Serve chilled.

m.note: the deep forest where the Great Prince watches
m.how: Slice 600g mixed mushrooms and a leek and cook in butter with thyme until soft and golden. Add 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Spoon into a pie dish, top with puff pastry, brush with milk and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.note: Bambi slipping around on the frozen pond
w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in a teaspoon of cornflour. Spread into a flat round like a frozen pond and bake at 120C for 90 minutes. Cool and top with whipped cream and berries.

d.note: spring in the meadow, when everyone is twitterpated
d.how: Fill tall glasses with ice, cucumber ribbons and mint leaves. Pour in apple juice to halfway and add a splash of elderflower cordial. Top with cold soda water and stir gently. Fresh as the first day of spring in the meadow.
